reason: Notify Frank Castle's patient-facing app of status changes on his surgical extraction / implant referral (Task/task-referral-tracking), so the app can surface milestone updates (referral sent, appointment confirmed, and — at Interaction 4 — referral complete) without Frank needing to call either office.

note.text: Per the HL7 FHIR Subscriptions R4 Backport IG, same pattern established for UC01/UC02a: the SubscriptionTopic canonical URL is carried directly in Subscription.criteria, not via a separate extension. This single Subscription spans the whole UC02b episode. Unlike UC02a, there is NO 'prior authorization approved' milestone here — commercial coverage in UC02b requires no PA — so the patient-visible milestones are: referral sent (I1), appointment confirmed (I2), and referral complete (I4, not yet built). Interaction 3 (the surgical visit itself) is deliberately NOT a patient-notification milestone.
